# eMuleBB

<img src="https://emulebb.github.io/assets/brand/emulebb-logo-256.png" width="160" height="160" alt="eMuleBB Rust pixel donkey identity" />

[![Rust CI](https://github.com/emulebb/emulebb-rust/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/emulebb/emulebb-rust/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Docs](https://github.com/emulebb/emulebb-tooling/actions/workflows/docs-site.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/emulebb/emulebb-tooling/actions/workflows/docs-site.yml)

**Contents:** [Use or develop](#use-or-develop) · [Repositories](#work-across-the-project) · [Support](#keep-in-touch)

eMuleBB Rust is an eD2K/Kad client for Windows, Linux and macOS, operated through a browser console and authenticated REST API.

**Active beta.** CI-gated nightly builds are the public testing channel. Beta 3 is the next development target.

## Use or develop

| Use eMuleBB Rust | Develop with eMuleBB Rust |
| --- | --- |
| [First launch and daily use](https://emulebb.github.io/emulebb-tooling/products/emulebb-rust/reference/GUIDE-GETTING-STARTED/) | [Contribute to the client](https://emulebb.github.io/emulebb-tooling/products/emulebb-rust/reference/GUIDE-CONTRIBUTING/) |
| [Choose a platform and package](https://emulebb.github.io/emulebb-tooling/products/emulebb-rust/reference/GUIDE-DOWNLOADS-PLATFORMS/) | [Build against the REST API](https://emulebb.github.io/emulebb-tooling/products/emulebb-rust/api/GUIDE-API-CONSUMERS/) |

- **Browser operation:** search eD2K/Kad, manage transfers and monitor chosen shared folders from the packaged console.
- **Automation:** use authenticated REST requests and the documented API contract.
- **Explicit network controls:** review interface settings, connection status and diagnostics.
- **Identifiable builds:** inspect source-bound package manifests, checksums and provenance.

See the platform guide for package checks, network-validation scope and the limits of the published proof.

- [Choose the newest dated nightly build](https://github.com/emulebb/emulebb-rust/releases)
- [Report eMuleBB Rust issues](https://github.com/emulebb/emulebb-rust/issues)

## Maintenance and references

eMuleBB Rust is the active product-development lane. The MFC client remains the stable Windows diagnostic baseline and may receive critical fixes and bounded, low-risk maintenance.

- [Stable maintenance downloads](https://github.com/emulebb/emulebb/releases/tag/emulebb-v0.7.3): Version 0.7.3 remains published while the 0.7.x line provides diagnostics, critical fixes, and bounded maintenance.

<details>
<summary>Test infrastructure and compatibility references</summary>

- [`emulebb`](https://github.com/emulebb/emulebb): Stable 0.7.x Windows client, diagnostic baseline, and critical-fix maintenance lane.
- [`ed2k-server`](https://github.com/emulebb/ed2k-server): Sole local deterministic eD2K server, maintained as a minimal upstream-aligned Rust fork.
- [aMule upstream](https://github.com/amule-org/amule) (`master`): Actively developed upstream client used for analysis and future interoperability.
- [eMule stock 0.72](https://github.com/irwir/eMule) (`v0.72a`): Stock compatibility baseline for protocol and state-machine parity.

</details>
